intended_object: The real part map Re : ℂ → ℝ, z ↦ Re z, seen as an ℝ-linear map (from the docstring and the name).
explanation: The function is `x ↦ x.re`. It is additive by `add_re`, and it respects real scalars because Re(r·z) = r·Re z for real r. So this is exactly the real part as an element of ℂ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ. `RCLike.reLm`, in Mathlib/Analysis/RCLike/Basic.lean, defines the same map for any `RCLike` field, so it covers ℝ as well as ℂ. That does not make this definition too narrow: the real part of a complex number is one specific map, and Mathlib normally gives the complex case its own basic definition alongside the general `RCLike` one.
